mapper.select: SELECT /* getElection */ VOTE.CLUB_NUMB , VOTE.ELCT_NUMB , VOTE.VOTE_NUMB , VOTE.VOTE_ROUN , VOTE.ENDX_DATE , CASE WHEN VOTE.STRT_DATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND VOTE.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS CAN_VOTE , CASE WHEN BALLOT.USER_NUMB IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS VOTED FROM TM_CLVOTX VOTE JOIN TM_CLOWNX ELECTION ON ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB = VOTE.CLUB_NUMB AND ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB = VOTE.ELCT_NUMB AND ELECTION.ELCT_STAT IN ('OPEN', 'RUNOFF', 'EXTENDED') JOIN TB_CLVOTR VOTER ON VOTER.CLUB_NUMB = VOTE.CLUB_NUMB AND VOTER.VOTE_NUMB = VOTE.VOTE_NUMB AND VOTER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = VOTER.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = VOTER.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TB_CLVBAL BALLOT ON BALLOT.CLUB_NUMB = VOTER.CLUB_NUMB AND BALLOT.VOTE_NUMB = VOTER.VOTE_NUMB AND BALLOT.USER_NUMB = VOTER.USER_NUMB WHERE VOTE.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND VOTE.VOTE_TYPE = 'OWNER' AND VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'OPEN' ORDER BY VOTE.VOTE_ROUN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* getCandidateList */ OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , OPTIONX.TAGT_NAME AS USER_NICK , PROFILE.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , CASE WHEN BALLOT.TAGT_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS SELECTED FROM TB_CLVOPT OPTIONX JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM PROFILE ON PROFILE.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CLVBAL BALLOT ON BALLOT.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND BALLOT.VOTE_NUMB = OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB AND BALLOT.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb} AND OPTIONX.OPTI_STAT = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB

SELECT /* getEligibleVoterCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_CLVOTR VOTER JOIN TM_CLVOTX VOTE ON VOTE.CLUB_NUMB = VOTER.CLUB_NUMB AND VOTE.VOTE_NUMB = VOTER.VOTE_NUMB AND VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'OPEN' AND VOTE.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = VOTER.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = VOTER.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE VOTER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND VOTER.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb} AND VOTER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getEligibleOptionCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_CLVOPT OPTIONX JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb} AND OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND OPTIONX.OPTI_STAT = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT /* getPendingClubList */ CLUB.CLUB_NUMB FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB WHERE CLUB.CLUB_STAT = 'OWNER_ELECTION' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_CLOWNX ELECTION WHERE ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB AND ELECTION.ELCT_STAT IN ('OPEN', 'RUNOFF', 'EXTENDED') ) ORDER BY CLUB.CLUB_NUMB LIMIT #{maxSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT /* getNextElectionNumb */ COALESCE(MAX(ELCT_NUMB), 0) + 1 FROM TM_CLOWNX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}
SELECT /* getNextVoteNumb */ COALESCE(MAX(VOTE_NUMB), 0) + 1 FROM TM_CLVOTX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}
mapper.insert: /* setElection */ INSERT INTO TM_CLOWNX ( CLUB_NUMB , ELCT_NUMB , PREV_OWNR , ABSN_RSON , ELCT_STAT , EXTN_YSNO , STRT_DATE , ENDX_DATE , IDEM_KEYX , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE ) SELECT CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , #{elctNumb} , CLUB.OWNR_NUMB , 'OWNER_ABSENT' , 'OPEN' , 'N' , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) , CONCAT('OWNER_ELECTION:', CLUB.CLUB_NUMB, ':', #{elctNumb}) , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB WHERE CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = 'OWNER_ELECTION'

/* setVote */ INSERT INTO TM_CLVOTX ( CLUB_NUMB , VOTE_NUMB , VOTE_TYPE , VOTE_ROUN , PRNT_VOTE , ELCT_NUMB , VOTE_TITL , VOTE_STAT , SECR_YSNO , CHNG_YSNO , STRT_DATE , ENDX_DATE , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{clubNumb} , #{voteNumb} , 'OWNER' , #{voteRoun} , #{prntVote,jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{elctNumb} , '모임장 선거' , 'OPEN' , 'Y' , 'N' , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )

/* setCandidateList */ INSERT INTO TB_CLVOPT ( CLUB_NUMB , VOTE_NUMB , TAGT_NUMB , TAGT_NAME , OPTI_STAT , REGI_DATE ) SELECT MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , #{voteNumb} , MEMBER.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , 'ACTIVE' , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB AND (CLUB.OWNR_NUMB IS NULL OR CLUB.OWNR_NUMB != MEMBER.USER_NUMB) WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'

/* setRunoffCandidateList */ INSERT INTO TB_CLVOPT ( CLUB_NUMB , VOTE_NUMB , TAGT_NUMB , TAGT_NAME , OPTI_STAT , REGI_DATE ) SELECT RESULT.CLUB_NUMB , #{voteNumb} , RESULT.TAGT_NUMB , RESULT.TAGT_NAME , 'ACTIVE' , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM ( SELECT OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB , OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB , OPTIONX.TAGT_NAME , COUNT(BALLOT.USER_NUMB) AS VOTE_CNT , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(BALLOT.USER_NUMB) DESC) AS VOTE_RANK FROM TB_CLVOPT OPTIONX JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TB_CLVBAL BALLOT ON BALLOT.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND BALLOT.VOTE_NUMB = OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB AND BALLOT.TAGT_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB WHERE OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB = #{prntVote} GROUP BY OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB, OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB, OPTIONX.TAGT_NAME ) RESULT WHERE RESULT.VOTE_RANK = 1 AND RESULT.VOTE_CNT > 0

/* setVoterList */ INSERT INTO TB_CLVOTR ( CLUB_NUMB , VOTE_NUMB , USER_NUMB , ELIG_YSNO , REGI_DATE ) SELECT MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , #{voteNumb} , MEMBER.USER_NUMB , 'Y' , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptElectionRunoff */ TM_CLOWNX SET ELCT_STAT = 'RUNOFF' , ENDX_DATE = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ELCT_NUMB = #{elctNumb} AND ELCT_STAT IN ('OPEN', 'EXTENDED')
mapper.select: SELECT /* getDueVoteList */ VOTE.CLUB_NUMB , VOTE.ELCT_NUMB , VOTE.VOTE_NUMB , VOTE.PRNT_VOTE , VOTE.VOTE_ROUN , ELECTION.EXTN_YSNO FROM TM_CLVOTX VOTE JOIN TM_CLOWNX ELECTION ON ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB = VOTE.CLUB_NUMB AND ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB = VOTE.ELCT_NUMB WHERE VOTE.VOTE_TYPE = 'OWNER' AND VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'OPEN' AND VOTE.ENDX_DATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY VOTE.ENDX_DATE, VOTE.CLUB_NUMB, VOTE.VOTE_NUMB LIMIT #{maxSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptInvalidVoter */ TB_CLVOTR VOTER SET VOTER.ELIG_YSNO = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = VOTER.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = VOTER.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHERE VOTER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND VOTER.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb}
mapper.select: SELECT /* getWinnerList */ RESULT.USER_NUMB , RESULT.VOTE_CNT FROM ( SELECT OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , COUNT(BALLOT.USER_NUMB) AS VOTE_CNT , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(BALLOT.USER_NUMB) DESC) AS VOTE_RANK FROM TB_CLVOPT OPTIONX JOIN TB_CLMEMX CANDIDATE ON CANDIDATE.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND CANDIDATE.USER_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB AND CANDIDATE.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' JOIN TM_USERXM CANDIDATE_USER ON CANDIDATE_USER.USER_NUMB = CANDIDATE.USER_NUMB AND CANDIDATE_USER.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TB_CLVBAL BALLOT ON BALLOT.CLUB_NUMB = OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB AND BALLOT.VOTE_NUMB = OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB AND BALLOT.TAGT_NUMB = OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB WHERE OPTIONX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND OPTIONX.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb} AND OPTIONX.OPTI_STAT = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY OPTIONX.TAGT_NUMB ) RESULT WHERE RESULT.VOTE_RANK = 1 AND RESULT.VOTE_CNT > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptPreviousOwner */ TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB AND CLUB.OWNR_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB SET MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE = 'MEMBER' , MEMBER.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE /* uptNextOwner */ TB_CLMEMX SET MEMB_ROLE = 'OWNER' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{winnerNumb} AND MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE /* uptClubOwner */ TM_CLUBXM SET OWNR_NUMB = #{winnerNumb} , CLUB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_STAT = 'OWNER_ELECTION'

UPDATE /* uptElectionExtended */ TM_CLOWNX ELECTION JOIN TM_CLVOTX VOTE ON VOTE.CLUB_NUMB = ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB AND VOTE.ELCT_NUMB = ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB SET ELECTION.ELCT_STAT = 'EXTENDED' , ELECTION.EXTN_YSNO = 'Y' , ELECTION.ENDX_DATE = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) , ELECTION.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , VOTE.ENDX_DATE = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) , VOTE.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB = #{elctNumb} AND VOTE.VOTE_NUMB = #{voteNumb} AND ELECTION.EXTN_YSNO = 'N' AND VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'OPEN'

UPDATE /* uptElectionPaused */ TM_CLOWNX ELECTION JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB JOIN TM_CLVOTX VOTE ON VOTE.CLUB_NUMB = ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB AND VOTE.ELCT_NUMB = ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB SET ELECTION.ELCT_STAT = 'PAUSED' , ELECTION.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CLUB.CLUB_STAT = 'PAUSED' , CLUB.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'CLOSED' , VOTE.CLOS_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , VOTE.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ELECTION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ELECTION.ELCT_NUMB = #{elctNumb} AND VOTE.VOTE_STAT = 'OPEN'
